.AVIATION...

East-southeastly flow off western Lake Erie led to the development 
of a fog plume overnight. With the flow turning more south-
southeasterly, much of this fog has remained south and west of the 
terminals. A gradual weakening of the flow toward daybreak may 
support some shallow radiational fog at the TAF sites. Otherwise, 
expansive high pressure across the region will sustain light winds 
and clear skies through today. 

D21/DTW Convection... Thunderstorms are not forecast through the TAF
